name: indulgence
quote: A big piece of chocolate cake please.
description: Engaging in something pleasurable that part of your mind knows is not necessary and has downsides.

variations.name: indulgence signaling
variations.description: May be socially motivated to follow a group's conventions.

variations.name: guilty pleasure
variations.description: May come with guilt for not being able to resist.

commentaries.quote: Indulgence is an unsucessful encounter with temptation.

conditions: Self gives in to a temptation
